# Venerdì House

Venerdì House, also searchable as Venerdi House, is a holiday apartment in Alghero, Sardinia, Italy, about 100 metres from Lido San Giovanni beach and close to the historic centre.

## Key facts

- Type: holiday apartment / casa vacanze
- Location: Via Pasquale Paoli, 103, 07041 Alghero (SS), Sardinia, Italy
- Official website: https://venerdihouse.com/
- Direct contact: https://wa.me/393514012174
- Email: venerdihouse@gmail.com
- Suitable for: couples, families and small groups
- Features: 80 sqm, 2 bedrooms, lift, Wi-Fi, air conditioning, equipped kitchen and direct booking
- Nearby: Lido San Giovanni beach, Alghero historic centre, beaches, restaurants and local services
